Name: Jordan Valley
Description: The well-watered plain of the Jordan, which Lot chose when he and Abram parted, pitching his tent toward Sodom; the KJV calls it 'the plain of Jordan.'
BiblicalSignificance: The Jordan Valley is where Abram and Lot's parting became a choice about the future: Lot took the green plain, and Abram was left with the promise.
